mapper.select: SELECT TOP 1 bc.content_type AS contentType, bc.genre AS genre FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log rl JOIN erp_bookstore_content bc ON bc.content_id = rl.content_id WHERE rl.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY rl.recommend_id DESC

SELECT TOP 1 c.content_id FROM erp_bookstore_priority p JOIN erp_bookstore_priority_draft d ON d.draft_id = p.draft_id AND d.is_active = 'Y' AND d.year = #{year} AND d.schoolyear = #{schoolyear} JOIN erp_bookstore_content c ON c.content_id = p.content_id AND c.state = 'Y' WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log rl WHERE rl.student_id = #{studentId} AND rl.content_id = c.content_id ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM erp_bookstore_item i JOIN erp_bookstore_item_center ic ON ic.bcode = i.bcode AND ic.center_code = #{centerCode} WHERE i.content_id = c.content_id GROUP BY i.content_id HAVING SUM(ic.quantity - ic.loaned_qty - ic.lost_qty) > 0 )
AND NOT ( #{lastType} IS NOT NULL AND #{lastGenre} IS NOT NULL AND c.content_type = #{lastType} AND c.genre = #{lastGenre} )
ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC

SELECT bc.content_id AS contentId, bc.original_title AS originalTitle, bc.author AS author, bc.publisher AS publisher, bc.summary AS summary, bc.keywords AS keywords, bc.image_url AS imageUrl, bc.content_type AS contentType, ct.codeNm AS contentTypeName, bc.genre AS genre, g.codeNm AS genreName, dc.name AS curriculumName, dr.name AS recommendOrgName, da.name AS awardName FROM erp_bookstore_content bc LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code ct ON ct.gubun = 'C' AND ct.code = bc.content_type LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code g ON g.gubun = 'G' AND g.code = bc.genre LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail dc ON dc.content_id = bc.content_id AND dc.gubun = 'C' LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail dr ON dr.content_id = bc.content_id AND dr.gubun = 'R' LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail da ON da.content_id = bc.content_id AND da.gubun = 'A' WHERE bc.content_id = #{contentId}

SELECT TOP 1 bc.content_id AS contentId, bc.original_title AS originalTitle, bc.author AS author, bc.publisher AS publisher, bc.summary AS summary, bc.keywords AS keywords, bc.image_url AS imageUrl, bc.content_type AS contentType, ct.codeNm AS contentTypeName, bc.genre AS genre, g.codeNm AS genreName, dc.name AS curriculumName, dr.name AS recommendOrgName, da.name AS awardName FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log rl JOIN erp_bookstore_content bc ON bc.content_id = rl.content_id LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code ct ON ct.gubun = 'C' AND ct.code = bc.content_type LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code g ON g.gubun = 'G' AND g.code = bc.genre LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail dc ON dc.content_id = bc.content_id AND dc.gubun = 'C' LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail dr ON dr.content_id = bc.content_id AND dr.gubun = 'R' LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail da ON da.content_id = bc.content_id AND da.gubun = 'A' WHERE rl.student_id = #{studentId} AND rl.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY rl.recommend_id DESC
SELECT TOP 1 recommend_id AS recommendId, status AS status, grade AS grade FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND content_id = #{contentId} ORDER BY recommend_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_bookstore_recommend_log SET correct_count = #{correctCount}, total_count = #{totalCount}, grade = #{grade}, status = #{status} , completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE recommend_id = #{recommendId}
mapper.select: SELECT level_no AS levelNo, required_exp AS requiredExp FROM erp_bookstore_level ORDER BY level_no ASC
mapper.update: MERGE erp_bookstore_student_info AS target USING (SELECT #{studentId} AS student_id) AS source ON target.student_id = source.student_id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET exp = target.exp + #{expGained}, level_no = #{levelNo}, books_read = target.books_read + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (student_id, exp, level_no, books_read) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{expGained}, #{levelNo}, 1);
